name: stavya-intelligence-hms
description: Stavya Intelligence HMS - Hospital Management System

scripts.build:www: if exist www rmdir /s /q www && mkdir www && xcopy css www\css /E /I /Y && xcopy js www\js /E /I /Y && xcopy assets www\assets /E /I /Y && copy index.html www\ && copy dashboard.html www\
scripts.capacitor:sync: npm run build:www && npx cap sync android
scripts.build:apk: npm run capacitor:sync && cd android && .\gradlew assembleDebug
